description: Single storey rear extension; conversion of garage into habitable room; external alterations
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding the details submitted, no development
(excluding demolition) shall commence until a detailed scheme for the
management of surface water arising from the development has been submitted to
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">The scheme shall include:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">Compensatory Flood
Storage (CFS): &nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">CFS Required
details:</p><p class="MsoNormal">Site plan indicating the proposed and
     existing development; flood zone extent and depth category; proposed area
     of displaced flood water / compensatory storage area; section marks</p><p class="MsoNormal">Cross sections of CFS showing
     proposed and existing ground levels in relation to finished floor levels
     should be submitted.</p><p class="MsoNormal">Please mark FFL as 0.00m and mark existing (-0.ABm) and
lowered (-0.XYm) ground levels at the location of CFS.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p><br></o:p>Mitigation Measures:</p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">Detailed
description of building materials, foundations, floor, walls, fittings,
services, doors and windows that minimise water entry whilst maintaining
structural integrity, materials and construction techniques that facilitate
drying and cleaning, in line with CLG 2007 'Improving the Flood Performance of
New Buildings' publication should be provided taking into account the depth of
flooding.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><br></p><p class="MsoNormal">Drainage
     Details:</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">A drainage layout drawing showing surface and foul water connections
and their outfall details from the proposed development should be submitted.
&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">Water butts
cannot be considered as a means of disposal of surface water, as they are full
most year-round and should be connected to an outfall for draining.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span lang="EN-US">If a
soakaway is provided, please request the applicant to submit full construction
details of the soakaway with its location, size, storage volume and
calculations. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><a name="_Hlk216860320"><span lang="EN-US">The soakaway should be located at a minimum of 5m away from any building
and should be designed for a volume of 1m3&nbsp;of empty storage
for&nbsp; every 16m2 of hard standing/roof area draining into it.</span></a><span lang="EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal">Permeable
     Paving:</p><p>







































</p><p class="MsoNormal"><a name="_Hlk217340835"><span lang="EN-US">Full construction details of permeable paving
with their maintenance plan. Please note that a minimum of 250mm granular
subbase should be proposed to provide adequate storage underneath.</span></a><span lang="EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
